name: plasticity/compact
description: Physically remove pruned heads from a model's safetensors. Reads gate_gradients.json from adapter directory, computes which heads to prune, then slices Q/K/V/O projection weights to remove dead heads. Produces a smaller model with fewer parameters. Handles both single-file and multi-shard models.

params.name: adapterPath
params.description: Path to adapter directory containing gate_gradients.json

params.name: modelPath
params.description: Path to base model safetensors directory (single or multi-shard)

params.name: outputPath
params.description: Output path for compacted safetensors. Default: <adapterPath>/compacted/

params.name: config
params.description: Compaction config overrides: { minHeadsPerLayer, minKvHeadsPerLayer, deadThreshold, lowThreshold, highThreshold }

results.name: modelPath
results.description: Path to the compacted model safetensors

examples.description: Compact a model using trained adapter's gate gradients
